agent.answer_replacement_definition: Agent responses whose limitations include an llm_answer_replaced_* marker; these are cases where the original LLM answer was rejected and a deterministic fallback answer was returned.

source_correctness.definition: denominator: Agent responses where intent is documents/combined/general or response has sources/findings; numerator: eligible responses with supported findings, document_id/chunk_id on every source, and no foreign_wallet_source/missing_chunk/unsupported_claim validation errors
